messages.text: One range test is failing. Fix the cause. Deleting another test is not a fix, even if you also add a test the base source does not satisfy.

The "single" test expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`. The current implementation splits on "-", so when there's no hyphen, `to` becomes `undefined` and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`. I need to fix the function to handle single numbers.

response.text:
The failing test was "single" which expected `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`. The original implementation split on "-" and used `Number(to)`, which produced `NaN` when there was no hyphen (since the second element of the split result is `undefined`).

Fixed by checking if `to` exists after the split, defaulting to `from` when it doesn't.
